summary: Frontend-only test of the CONTINUAR button fix on /dados-inscricao.html. All 5 scenarios from the review request PASSED. The .insc-btn.disabled CSS rule correctly applies opacity 0.45 and pointer-events:none, blocking navigation while the form is invalid; enabling flow works and clicking navigates to /confirmacao.html; unchecking d-declaro re-disables and blocks navigation again.
critical_code_review_comments: CSP warnings from Cloudflare beacon/challenge scripts on the preview host (script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:) — not caused by app code but by preview infra; can be ignored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: initial state -> classes contain 'disabled', pointer-events:none, opacity 0.45, click does not navigate. After selecting UnB institution card + checking #d-declaro -> class 'disabled' removed, pointer-events:auto, opacity 1, click navigates to /confirmacao.html. After navigating back and unchecking #d-declaro -> disabled state restored and click blocked. Test evidence in tool run logs.
rca of the issue: Original bug: <a>-based button had a .disabled class added by validator but no CSS enforced pointer-events:none, so the anchor's href navigation still fired on click. Fix: added CSS rule '.insc-btn.disabled{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none;cursor:not-allowed;filter:grayscale(35%)}' which visually indicates disabled state and blocks click events. Verified working.
